# Bundled standalone decoder

`7zr.exe` is the unmodified 7-Zip reduced standalone decoder, version 26.04.
Its embedded LegalCopyright is `Igor Pavlov : Public domain`.

Downloaded from https://www.7-zip.org/a/7zr.exe

SHA256: `256feca8e274e5da655e2a284fabafd9f554365eb164862089dacd4e8276d282`

Upstream: https://www.7-zip.org/ — https://github.com/ip7z/7zip
Source archive for the version: https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z2604-src.tar.xz
The upstream general license text is included as `7zip-LICENSE.txt` for attribution.
This application only uses the reduced decoder to unpack its own embedded bundle.
